item.alchyforbidden.rift_eye.tooltip.1: Held, it looks where it wants you to go.
item.alchyforbidden.rift_eye.tooltip.2: Use it, and it tells you what it wants.
altar.alchyforbidden.unformed: The altar's floor is not whole: %s
altar.alchyforbidden.regrow: The altar wants to grow back. Clear the way, then touch it.
altar.alchyforbidden.whole: Tier %s. The altar wants nothing more, for now.
altar.alchyforbidden.blocked: The rift cannot grow through %s at %s %s %s.
altar.alchyforbidden.heard: Something in the deep heard that.
altar.alchyforbidden.drawn: The noise carried. Something is coming.
eye.alchyforbidden.set_altar: Set the altar down. A floor of deepslate under it, a candle on each corner, then me on it.
eye.alchyforbidden.carve_altar: Carve the altar. Deepslate, amethyst, and the echo you carry.
eye.alchyforbidden.seek_echo: Down. Where the deep dark sleeps, there is echo.
eye.alchyforbidden.no_echo: No echo near. Go deeper, or farther.
altar.alchyforbidden.no_eye: The altar sleeps. Set the eye on its center.
altar.alchyforbidden.eye_set: The eye opens over the altar.
altar.alchyforbidden.eye_taken: The eye closes. The altar sleeps.
item.alchyforbidden.rift_eye.tooltip.3: Set it on an altar to wake it. Holding it near one shows what the altar will grow.
gui.alchyforbidden.stand_sealed: This stand grows with the third tier
altar.alchyforbidden.no_rite: The altar knows no rite for what lies on its stands.
altar.alchyforbidden.rite_tier: That rite needs the altar at tier %s.
altar.alchyforbidden.rite_broken: Something was taken from a stand. The rite breaks.
gui.alchyforbidden.eye_slot: The eye: set here, it wakes the altar
gui.alchyforbidden.offer_slot: Offer: the altar takes what the next tier wants
item.alchyforbidden.vessel.fill: Fills with Wrath when you kill, with Sorrow in the dark
gui.alchyforbidden.pour_slot: Pour: vessels and sculk go into the altar's reserve
gui.alchyforbidden.essence_from.wrath: From vessels: kill hostile mobs carrying one
gui.alchyforbidden.essence_from.sorrow: From vessels: carry one in the dark
gui.alchyforbidden.essence_from.corrupti: Taken from mobs dying near a sculk catalyst, or sculk poured in
resonator.alchyforbidden.pearls: %s ender pearls, %s eyes of ender, %s Corruption waiting.

gui.alchyforbidden.eye_of_ender_slot: Eyes of ender: thrown before the pearls, they break less often
gui.alchyforbidden.resonator_waiting: %s / %s waiting for an altar with room
gui.alchyforbidden.resonator_no_altar: No awake altar with room within %s blocks: it keeps the Corruption
resonator.alchyforbidden.warden: The dead warden blasts the shriekers. %s Corruption waiting.
resonator.alchyforbidden.warden_slain: The warden falls. Its body goes into the resonator's rift.
resonator.alchyforbidden.heart: The heart flies round. %s Corruption waiting.
gui.alchyforbidden.resonator_needs_warde: Its last tier wants a warden killed beside it
